question: Derive LER predictions from the auxiliary K partition function, before pursuing transitions or decoder improvements.
scope: Exact Fourier/twist sector projection on the actual open graph; a closed-form rough-to-rough path LER; a fixed-size low-p exponent theorem for canonical square arrows. No claim of a solved moderate-p 2D curve.
theory_predictions: Z_a(Q)=(A_0(Q)+(-1)^a A_1(Q))/2, where A_t integrates K(phi+pi*t*cut) with measured-charge sources and boundary angles fixed at zero.
Bayes LER=(1-sum_Q abs(A_1(Q)))/2 for the normalized physical current prior.
A directed length-d path has Bayes LER=min((1-p)^d,p^d); the ternary path has a finite binomial closed form.
For the actual square arrows, fixed finite L and fixed 0<q<1 give Bayes LER=Theta(p^ceil((L-1)/2)); q=1 gives Theta(p^(L-1)).

validation.path: Exhaustive ternary states for d=1 through6 at p=.1,.3,.46 and q=.5,.75,.97,1; compare all-record closed-form LER.
validation.fourier: Exact discrete Fourier quadrature on square L3, grid9 per measured vertex, all charge records and both logical twists at p=.30,q=.75; compare joint sector weights to independent enumeration.
validation.square: Enumerate low-activity configurations up to the predicted leading order at L3,L4,L5, for fair and directed alphabets; determine the minimum over records of the larger sector activity order and its leading coefficient. The all-size result rests on the proof, not extrapolation of these tests.

stopping: Complete proofs, finite checks, current notes and rendered delivery. Keep full moderate-p 2D resummation explicitly unresolved.
post_initial_check_theory_extension: The first low-activity counts suggested the directed coefficient binom(2d,d), subsequently derived by counting monotone staircases. For even d, shortest-path ambiguity gives the interior-q coefficient (d+1)*binom(d,d/2)*min(q,1-q)^(d/2). These coefficient proofs and q=.75,.97 validation are exploratory additions, not preregistered discoveries.
note: Bounded analytic bridge is complete. Full moderate-p square curve remains the active lab question, not claimed solved by this contract.
